days.title: Patch Notes | November 1, 2026
days.summary: Team history on profiles and team pages, a new Changelog page, a new search, and matchmaking by region.

new.text: Player profiles now show current and previous teams, with available membership history.
Team pages show a roster history of current and former members.
The team activity feed shows when players join, rejoin, leave or are removed.
A new Changelog page under Info shows patch notes by day, with search, filters and a dot for new changes.
EU and SA are now separate region groups, and the Play page counts the queue for your region group.
Press Ctrl+K (Cmd+K on Mac) or use Search in the left menu to find pages, players, FAQ answers and your settings.

improved.text: Each region group can open or close matchmaking modes on its own, and the Play page shows what is open in your region.
If a mode closes while you are in its queue, you leave the queue and get a message.
Choose EU or SA from a dropdown in settings or on your profile. Staff approve the change.
Your notifications, friends and My Matches appear sooner when a page opens.
The Teams page, league seasons, tournament bracket previews and the utility library stay quick when many people view them at once.
The scoreboard keeps players in ADR order in every view, rows move smoothly when their positions change, and stat numbers roll like an odometer.
The team page tabs are one full-width bar under the team header, with the active tab highlighted, and it stays on screen while you scroll.
K/D, HS% and rating boards filtered by source or role load much faster.

fixed.text: Stream and demo startup progress now shows the workshop map download in the right order.
When a mode is closed, a ready check that fails no longer puts you back in its queue or starts a new one.
A clip you make private leaves the public Highlights and Watch lists right away.
Team cards show a space before "vs" in the Next and Last rows.
